facts.fact: The course opened in 1895 inside the Presidio, then an Army post, by permission of its commander, Colonel William M. Graham.
The gun is a generic field piece, not a particular one at the Presidio; no Golden Gate Bridge and no club or park marks (interpretation).

concepts.name: The Fort Gun
concepts.rationale: An old fort's bronze field gun on its wooden carriage, a golf ball at the muzzle, on the parade-ground lawn.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
